title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Account Reconciliation: Credit Balance and Refund Amount
content:
# Account Reconciliation Note — Credit Balance and Refund Amount on a Turned-In Unit, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Calculation.** The credit balance of a turned-in unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease is the unit's charges due balance taken as a positive figure where it stands below zero, that is the amount by which the payments, credits and waivers posted to the unit exceed its rentals and charges. The refund is the whole credit balance, never below zero, rounded to the nearest cent.

**Order of figuring.** Any holdback is subtracted from the credit balance, the refund never going below zero, and the refund is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end.

## Reading the charges due balance

| Charges due balance on the unit | Credit balance | Refund |
|---|---|---|
| below zero | the balance taken as a positive figure | that figure |
| zero | none | 0.00 |
| above zero (charges exceed payments, credits and waivers) | none | 0.00 |

## Worked examples (hypothetical)

1. Charges due balance of minus 1234.56: the credit balance is 1234.56 and the refund 1234.56.
2. Charges due balance of 50.00: there is no credit balance; the refund is 0.00, never below zero.

## Points of judgement

- **Which figure is read?** The charges due balance standing on the unit itself, not on other units of the master agreement.
- **Is the refund rounded?** Once, to the nearest cent, at the end.
